appearance_facts.fact: Five vertical bars are shown in order: Utility solar (yellow), Offshore wind (light blue), Hydro storage (blue), Bioenergy (green), Geothermal heat (brown).
The yellow bar is the leftmost; its top edge aligns near the 40-41 tick region on the y-axis.
The light blue bar is the second from left and is the tallest bar on the page; its top edge is near the 68-69 tick region.
The blue bar is third from left; its top edge is near the 52-53 tick region.
The green bar is fourth from left and is the shortest bar; its top edge is near the 22-23 tick region.
The brown bar is the rightmost; its top edge is near the 35 tick region.
Each bar has a bold percentage label directly above it: 41.2%, 29.8%, 18.5%, 7.2%, 3.3%.
A y-axis title reads 'Reported clean-grid share (%)' and the axis runs from 0 to 70 in increments of 5.

printed_facts.fact: Categories left to right: 'Utility solar', 'Offshore wind', 'Hydro storage', 'Bioenergy', 'Geothermal heat'.

uncertain: The bar heights (visual magnitude) and the printed percentage annotations are inconsistent: Offshore wind has the tallest bar but the second-highest annotation (29.8%), while Utility solar has the highest annotation (41.2%) but a shorter bar. It is unclear which channel (bar height vs. annotation) defines 'largest contribution' for routing.
